title: The Nernst equation
caption: E = E° + (RT/nF) ln[Cu²⁺] = 0.34 + 0.0296 log₁₀[Cu²⁺] at 298 K. Diluting the Cu²⁺ tenfold lowers the electrode potential by 0.0296 V (59 mV divided by the 2 electrons).
alt: Electrode potential against log of the copper(II) concentration: a straight line of gradient 0.0296, passing 0.34 V at 1 mol dm⁻³.
description: At [Cu²⁺] = 1 mol dm⁻³ (log 0): E = E° = 0.34 V.
